description: Validate Silero VAD v6 and TEN VAD (license review) under ONNX Runtime Web on WASM and WebGPU. Known-answer test, latency per frame, placement. Desktop evidence: WASM 0.27 ms p50 vs WebGPU 11 ms, so WASM is the expected target.
title: Benchmark VAD options (Silero VAD v6, TEN VAD) on WebGPU/WASM
